scope: Post-hoc DEV counterfactual routing using only two already-completed PixelPrune outputs, no new labels or generation
rule: When observed t045 K is <= the route threshold, use the already observed t0 output, score and K; otherwise use already observed t045. This is a counterfactual identity assumption, not an executed conditional model.
token_summary: mean, median, nearest-rank P95, minimum, maximum and number of fallbacks, all on 128 questions per task
limitations: Thresholds and candidate were chosen after observing DEV scores and K strata; all routes and contrasts reported as exploratory only
Offline combination of two previously run outputs assumes a new conditional selector reproduces those outputs; no such identity has yet been shown
Threshold decision uses unlabelled t045 K but requires both selectors for fallback items; actual extra work and model timing not measured
K is not FLOPs, actual latency or memory, nor equal-compute evidence
No CONFIRM or FINAL; no new predictions, labels or causal claim
